title: Three Price Tiers Revealed As Xbox Rolls Out 'Cloud Playtime' To Insiders
summary:
A new way to access Xbox Cloud Gaming.

We've heard for a while now that Xbox has been interested in offering a new way to pay for Xbox Cloud Gaming without requiring access to Xbox Game Pass, and it's being trialled with Xbox Insiders from today.

They're calling this service "Cloud Playtime", and at least initially, it's being offered in three variants with three different price tiers. The smallest amount costs $3.99 for 10 hours, and the largest costs $11.99 for 50 hours.

title: Mass Effect 5 Cancelled As Legendary Developer BioWare Closes Down
summary:
"There is nothing easy about writing these words.".

In some absolutely shock news today, it's been announced that legendary development studio BioWare is closing down after 30 years, and the next entry in the Mass Effect series has been cancelled as a result.

BioWare shared a statement on social media confirming this, also shouting out games like Baldur's Gate, Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic and Dragon Age as being some of the classic series' they've worked on over the years.

title: Xbox CTO Issues Statement On How Project Helix OS Is Being 'Built On Windows'
summary:
Which perhaps confusingly means it'll likely follow the Series X and S.

Yesterday, when Fortune published their big piece about Xbox, mentioning there had been internal clashes between the Xbox and Windows teams about the operating system for the next generation of Xbox hardware, people started to question what kind of OS we might actually be looking at on the Project Helix console and beyond.

After Windows Central had published their report on this, Xbox CTO Scott Van Vliet decided to chime in, confirming the Helix OS is "being built on Windows" and stating that the report from Fortune (and subsequently Windows Central) "misrepresents both the technical work and the relationship between the teams" at Xbox and Windows.

title: AMD FSR 4.1 Announced For Xbox Series X|S And ROG Xbox Handhelds
summary:
"And there's even more ahead with Project Helix...".

Today, AMD and Xbox announced plans to bring FSR 4.1 to the ROG Xbox Ally X and Xbox Series X|S consoles in the future. Until now, Sony hardware has dominated the upscaling conversation with its QSSR tech, but it looks like Xbox is set to have its own horse in the race.

FSR (FidelityFX Super Resolution) 4.1 is AMD's impressive upscaling tech, which renders games at a lower resolution before using machine learning (ML)-powered gaming technology to improve visual fidelity and boost performance.
